findings.title: Audit manifest and V1 closure claims are stale
findings.reachable_call_chain: plan_audit_tool.py -> validate/verify-manifest -> committed governance artifacts
findings.trigger: Run validators at the candidate commit.
findings.impact: A closed gate can be accepted from invalid counts and hashes.
findings.reproduction: validate exits 1; verify-manifest reports 1,601 errors.
findings.validation_test: All governance validators must exit 0 from a clean checkout.

findings.title: Assembly provenance is pinned to an older commit
findings.reachable_call_chain: MSBuild -> RepositoryCommit -> assembly metadata
findings.trigger: Build candidate a03d021 without overriding MSBuild properties.
findings.impact: Produced binaries can claim commit 8b7a4bf instead of the audited source.
findings.reproduction: Compare Directory.Build.props:22 with git rev-parse HEAD.
findings.validation_test: Build all projects and assert assembly RepositoryCommit equals the candidate.

findings.title: CI does not enforce clean restore/build/test/security/coverage
findings.reachable_call_chain: GitHub PR -> single task-scope job
findings.trigger: Open a PR with a compile, test, vulnerability, or coverage regression outside task metadata.
findings.impact: Production regressions can merge without an automated release-quality gate.
findings.reproduction: Only task-scope.yml is tracked under .github/workflows.
findings.validation_test: CI must run locked restore, Release build/test, coverage, provenance, SBOM and vulnerability gates.

findings.title: Cashier mutations authenticate but never authorize permissions
findings.reachable_call_chain: HTTP mutation -> RequireCashierAsync -> token/device lookup -> store mutation
findings.trigger: Use any active cashier account without an assigned mutation permission.
findings.impact: Authenticated low-privilege users can create/change/submit orders and manage displays.
findings.reproduction: No IAuthorizationService call exists in Host/DualScreen.
findings.validation_test: Real HTTP tests must prove authenticated unauthorized mutations return 403 and emit denial audit.

findings.title: Rate limits are global named windows rather than caller partitions
findings.reachable_call_chain: All callers -> one named FixedWindowRateLimiter instance
findings.trigger: Send ten login or pairing requests from one caller, then request from another.
findings.impact: One actor can exhaust quota for all terminals/displays; 429 has no Retry-After metadata.
findings.reproduction: Static inspection of AddFixedWindowLimiter registrations and OnRejected response.
findings.validation_test: HTTP tests must isolate terminal/display/principal/IP partitions and validate Retry-After.

findings.title: Plain HTTP and proxy/TLS boundaries are not fail-closed
findings.reachable_call_chain: --urls -> Kestrel listener -> password login -> Secure cookie
findings.trigger: Configure a non-loopback http:// URL and submit credentials.
findings.impact: Credentials cross plaintext transport; Secure cookies then make the session unusable. No trusted-proxy contract exists.
findings.reproduction: Options accepts arbitrary URL and Host contains no HTTPS/proxy guard.
findings.validation_test: Startup must reject non-loopback HTTP and tests must bind trusted proxies and secure cookies.

findings.title: Unhandled 500 failures are not logged
findings.reachable_call_chain: endpoint -> catch Exception -> WriteErrorAsync/Abort
findings.trigger: Throw an unexpected exception before or after response start.
findings.impact: Operators receive a trace ID but no server-side exception/trace record; started responses are silently aborted.
findings.reproduction: No ILogger call exists in exception middleware or WriteErrorAsync.
findings.validation_test: HTTP tests must assert sanitized 500 response and correlated structured error log in both paths.

findings.title: Raw exception text is persisted into operational records
findings.reachable_call_chain: provider/process exception -> ex.Message -> migration/backup result persistence
findings.trigger: Cause a connection/process error containing credentials, hostnames, or filesystem paths.
findings.impact: Secrets and infrastructure details can enter durable records and later UIs/logs.
findings.reproduction: Direct ex.Message assignments found by repository scan.
findings.validation_test: Redaction tests must inject secret-bearing exceptions and prove durable payloads contain only safe codes.

findings.title: Production HTTP surface has no end-to-end integration tests
findings.reachable_call_chain: tests -> DTO/options/token units only; no WebApplication HTTP client
findings.trigger: Search Host tests for API paths, 403, 429, HTTPS, cookies and exception logging.
findings.impact: Authorization, transport, limiter, cookie and middleware ordering regressions remain untested.
findings.reproduction: No DualScreenApplication/WebApplicationFactory HTTP test exists.
findings.validation_test: Real HTTPS Host tests must exercise login, pairing, mutations, revoke, reconnect and failures.

findings.title: PostgreSQL 001..038 rollback chain fails at migration 012
findings.reachable_call_chain: 038 down ... 012 down -> DROP EXTENSION btree_gist -> catalog exclusion constraint
findings.trigger: Apply 001..038, then run downs in reverse in a fresh PostgreSQL 18 database.
findings.impact: Rollback/rehearsal cannot complete; emergency downgrade is not reproducible.
findings.reproduction: Digest-pinned PG18 forward passed; down failed at 012 with dependent constraint.
findings.validation_test: Fresh PG18 forward/down/forward must exit 0 without CASCADE dropping unrelated objects.

findings.title: Cumulative order quantity bypasses the 999 limit
findings.reachable_call_chain: POST add item -> validate request quantity -> lock existing row -> add quantities -> update
findings.trigger: Add quantity 999, then add 1 for the same product and draft order.
findings.impact: Quantity becomes 1000; money calculations and downstream constraints accept an invalid domain value.
findings.reproduction: Only the increment is bounded; the summed value is not, and DB has no upper constraint.
findings.validation_test: Concurrency and DB constraint tests must reject cumulative values above 999 atomically.

findings.title: Catalog endpoint is unbounded and has no pagination contract
findings.reachable_call_chain: GET catalog -> unbounded ordered SELECT -> materialize entire catalog -> JSON
findings.trigger: Create a large active catalog and request /catalog.
findings.impact: Memory, latency and response size grow without a bounded dataset or cursor.
findings.reproduction: Query has neither LIMIT nor cursor/filter contract; no approved SLO exists.
findings.validation_test: Approve dataset/SLO, add cursor pagination, and record representative EXPLAIN ANALYZE.

findings.title: Customer display contract states collapse to generic active UI
findings.reachable_call_chain: order status -> snapshot state -> CustomerDisplay render
findings.trigger: Return Paying, Completed or Unavailable snapshots.
findings.impact: Paying/Unavailable are never produced by the store and all non-Idle states render the same total screen.
findings.reproduction: Switches cover Idle specially and otherwise fall through to active rendering.
findings.validation_test: Component/browser tests must assert distinct Paying, Completed and Unavailable content and actions.

findings.title: First non-401 display snapshot failure leaves infinite loading
findings.reachable_call_chain: initial refresh -> non-401 error -> afterFailure(null) -> paired remains false -> loading branch
findings.trigger: Open /display while snapshot returns 500/503 or malformed JSON.
findings.impact: Customer sees an endless preparation message with no error or retry.
findings.reproduction: Browser at 390x844 remained on loading after 5.5 seconds with unavailable backend.
findings.validation_test: Bounded-time browser test must expose a named error and working retry for non-401 failures.

findings.title: Pairing completion failures are hidden
findings.reachable_call_chain: 2s pairing poll -> non-409 failure -> freshness only
findings.trigger: Return 429/500/503 from pairing completion.
findings.impact: The code remains visible and polling continues without a clear failure/retry state.
findings.reproduction: Catch branch never sets pairingError or stops/restarts with bounded backoff.
findings.validation_test: Browser tests must cover 409 pending, 429 Retry-After, 5xx error and successful retry.

findings.title: Authenticated POS controls violate 44x44 touch targets
findings.reachable_call_chain: authenticated cashier UI -> header/quantity/revoke controls
findings.trigger: Render cashier with an active order on a touch viewport.
findings.impact: Critical logout, quantity and revoke controls are harder to operate and miss the acceptance threshold.
findings.reproduction: CSS defines 40px header actions, 38px quantity buttons and auto-height danger text.
findings.validation_test: Bounding-box test must prove every interactive target is at least 44x44 in all nine viewports.

findings.title: Focus indicator contrast is below the non-text threshold
findings.reachable_call_chain: keyboard focus -> rgba accent outline over light surfaces
findings.trigger: Focus controls on a white background.
findings.impact: The low-opacity outline can be imperceptible for keyboard users.
findings.reproduction: rgba(240,90,54,.35) composited on white is approximately 1.55:1, below 3:1.
findings.validation_test: Automated color calculation and keyboard screenshots must prove >=3:1 focus contrast.

findings.title: Authenticated UI/accessibility state matrix is unverified
findings.reachable_call_chain: real HTTPS login/pairing/order/reconnect -> nine viewport and accessibility matrix
findings.trigger: Attempt required states without .NET 10.0.302 Host and seeded identities.
findings.impact: Overflow, focus restoration, zoom, reduced motion, modal semantics and critical CTA visibility are unknown.
findings.reproduction: Only the unauthenticated login and initial display failure could be rendered.
findings.validation_test: Real-host two-context E2E must archive screenshots, DOM/a11y, focus, console/network and bbox data.

findings.title: WebPrototype loses its explicit MOCK identity on mobile
findings.reachable_call_chain: viewport <=900 -> prototype dock hides every child except an icon toggle
findings.trigger: Open WebPrototype at 430, 390 or 320 pixels without opening the dock.
findings.impact: A production-like POS appears without visible mock/prototype quarantine text and can be shipped accidentally.
findings.reproduction: Browser visible text omitted ALKAROS V1 · MOCK on all mobile viewports.
findings.validation_test: Mobile screenshots must show permanent, non-dismissible mock quarantine branding.

findings.title: WebPrototype has no CSP shipping boundary
findings.reachable_call_chain: static hosting -> inline/dynamic innerHTML-heavy mock UI
findings.trigger: Serve prototype from an ordinary static server.
findings.impact: If exposed, injected or future unescaped content has no browser policy backstop.
findings.reproduction: No CSP meta/header contract is present; app.js contains many innerHTML sinks.
findings.validation_test: Quarantine hosting test must assert restrictive CSP and negative DOM injection cases.

findings.title: WebPrototype touch targets are below 44x44
findings.reachable_call_chain: prototype cashier filters/theme/skip link -> rendered controls
findings.trigger: Measure visible controls at 1920, 430, 390 and 320 widths.
findings.impact: Frequently used filters are 38px high; theme control is narrower than 44px.
findings.reproduction: Browser bbox evidence lists the exact failing controls.
findings.validation_test: All visible interactive controls must measure at least 44x44 at the required viewports.

findings.title: Required .NET/psql/Python validation toolchain is unavailable
findings.reachable_call_chain: clean checkout -> exact toolchain -> locked restore/build/test/format/coverage
findings.trigger: Resolve .NET 10.0.302, psql client and Python 3.12.12 on the audit host.
findings.impact: Full solution and real Host acceptance cannot be certified.
findings.reproduction: .NET and psql are missing; bundled Python is 3.12.13 and has no pytest.
findings.validation_test: Independent clean rerun must use exact versions and archive every exit code.

findings.title: Security/supply-chain closure is incomplete
findings.reachable_call_chain: dependency locks/history -> vulnerability, SBOM, license and secret scans
findings.trigger: Run .NET vulnerability scan, SBOM generator and full-history secret scanner.
findings.impact: Known vulnerable packages, incompatible licenses or historical secrets may remain undiscovered.
findings.reproduction: pnpm audit/license passed, but dotnet/gitleaks/trivy/syft/grype are unavailable and no SBOM is tracked.
findings.validation_test: Clean CI must produce signed SBOM/license output and zero high-confidence history-secret findings.

findings.title: Database concurrency/restart/timeout/performance acceptance is incomplete
findings.reachable_call_chain: fresh PG18 -> full tests/concurrency/lease/restart/timeouts -> EXPLAIN ANALYZE
findings.trigger: Attempt required suite without .NET/psql host tools and approved dataset/SLO.
findings.impact: Race, timeout and query-plan regressions are not production-certified.
findings.reproduction: Only SQL forward/down execution was independently reproduced.
findings.validation_test: Fresh PG18 suite must cover concurrency, idempotency, fencing, restart, timeout and representative plans.

findings.title: External go-live evidence and signed approval are absent
findings.reachable_call_chain: device/provider/security/recovery evidence -> signed go-live -> production deployment
findings.trigger: Request current fiscal device, printer, QNB, Yemeksepeti, meal-card, QR, license, backup and assessment evidence.
findings.impact: Real money/customer deployment would proceed without required external proof.
findings.reproduction: Roadmap contains planned/blocked release evidence and no signed Approve artifact for this candidate.
findings.validation_test: Independent final audit must verify all external transcripts and a dated signed Approve decision.
